children: Producer prices in Serbia rose 9% year-on-year in August 2026, the most since February 2023, following a 6.2% gain in July.
Producer price inflation accelerated in manufacturing (10.3% vs 6.8%), mining and quarrying (12% vs 8.5%), and water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation activities (5.8% vs 3.9%).
On the other hand, inflation slowed for electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply (3.9% vs 5.8%).
Compared to the previous month, the PPI increased 1.9%.

title: Serbia Producer Inflation Highest Since 2023
